name: superpowers-automation
description: Two PostToolUse Write hooks that trigger forked advisor-review skills gating the superpowers workflow (spec -> writing-plans, plan -> subagent-driven-development). Hooks default off. A configure skill provides an interactive wizard. The save-advisor skill (forked, Sonnet) revises a target file to implement advisor feedback on demand.

hook_plans.title: Plans hook
hook_plans.description: Values: true = on writing docs/superpowers/plans/*.md, inject an instruction to invoke the plan-advisor-review skill with the file path; false = no injection. Default: false.

hook_specs.title: Specs hook
hook_specs.description: Values: true = on writing docs/superpowers/specs/*.md, inject an instruction to invoke the spec-advisor-review skill with the file path; false = no injection. Default: false.
